title: Frosty-XSX-Shipping.exe
capture: Stopped the unmodified staged retail executable at its first call to Xbox command queue slot 30 (RVA 0x5764f32) in a private Proton prefix. Read RDX and the 72 bytes at R8 and 32 bytes at R9 before the call. An existing separate reference rendering run reported frame 1 at 3840x2160 in DXGI_FORMAT_R10G10B10A2_UNORM.

call_site.plane_count_selection: RVA 0x5764eec selects two planes when the optional second surface is present. RVA 0x5764f16 selects one plane otherwise.
call_site.first_plane: RVAs 0x5764e39, 0x5764e41 and 0x5764e49 store the resource-array pointer, resource count and frame token.
call_site.present_parameters: RVA 0x5764db5 stores the floating-point threshold, and RVA 0x5764dc0 can set bit 0 at byte offset 24 on a separate branch.
call_site.call: RVA 0x5764f2b loads vtable offset 0xf0, and RVA 0x5764f32 calls it with both records on the caller stack.

translation: PresentX accepts a single resource, a default plane tail, and a zero-initialized parameter record with a threshold from 0 to 100. The desktop flip chain waits for VBlank. Scanline-dependent late-frame tearing and nonzero option fields are unsupported. A null parameter pointer retains the original shorter plane-prefix ABI.

guest_control.tested: 10% and 0% thresholds display distinct frames, guarded pixel readbacks, and rejection of a nonzero option in each record.
